outcome: Efficacy and safety of vasopressin therapy
cohort: Thirty-two term neonates with severe persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn (PPHN) and refractory hypoxia and/or refractory systemic hypotension.
finding: Rescue vasopressin therapy significantly improved oxygenation index, mean blood pressure, vasoactive infusion score, and lactate levels within 24 hours of commencement, resulting in reduced mortality in term neonates with severe PPHN and refractory hypoxia/hypotension.
